windows_firewall_enabled.risk: A disabled firewall can increase exposure to unauthorized network connections and malicious traffic.
windows_firewall_enabled.remediation: Enable Windows Defender Firewall for all network profiles.

microsoft_defender_enabled.risk: If Microsoft Defender Antivirus is disabled, the system may have reduced protection against malware and other malicious software.
microsoft_defender_enabled.remediation: Enable Microsoft Defender Antivirus and confirm that antivirus protection is active.

defender_realtime_protection_enabled.risk: Disabled real-time protection can allow malicious files or processes to run without being detected immediately.
defender_realtime_protection_enabled.remediation: Enable Microsoft Defender Real-Time Protection in Windows Security.

guest_account_enabled.risk: An enabled Guest account can provide unnecessary access to the system and increase the attack surface.
guest_account_enabled.remediation: Disable the Guest account unless it is specifically required.
